description: A cafe project composing cafe-ops with bookkeeping. Only this file, read at its committed revision, binds people and event signer groups, enables the supplier tool, the weekly schedule and automatic spawns, sets the data policy and decides which human acts need signatures (the cafe demo follows the waggle amendment, CM2, and PC3). Principals follow waggle; the service kind svc: comes with the waggle amendment (spec section 17). Tools the project does not list in policy.enable.tools stay disabled.

supplier-bridge.description: Verifies the supplier portal's webhook signature before it signs supplier events.

payment-bridge.description: Verifies the payment provider's webhook signature before it signs payment events.

wip.description: No more than five orders wait for a manager at once: a limit on a human-owned state.
